newsitem.title: USA: Applied Power to buy Everest Electronic.
newsitem.headline: Applied Power to buy Everest Electronic.

text.p: Applied Power Inc said Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire the assets of Everest Electronic Equipment for $52 million, subject to certain post-closing adjustments.
Anaheim, Calif.-based Everest manufactures custom and standard electronic enclosures used by the computer, telecommunications, data communications and other industries.
Everest has annualized sales of about $45 million. It will be integrated with Applied Power's Wright Line segment.
The combined Wright Line and Everest sales volume is expected to be about $170 million for the fiscal year ended August 31, 1997, said Applied Power president Philip Burkart.
